bespoke_faqs.a: Luke Littler was just 16 years old when he stormed to the 2024 PDC World Darts Championship final on debut, defeating former world champions Raymond van Barneveld and Rob Cross before finishing runner-up to Luke Humphries.

bespoke_faqs.a: In his sensational 2024 debut season, Littler captured the Premier League Darts title at London's O2 Arena, the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton, and the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam.

bespoke_faqs.q: Has Luke Littler hit a televised nine-dart finish?
bespoke_faqs.a: Yes. Littler has achieved multiple televised nine-darters, including a historic perfect leg against Nathan Aspinall at the 2024 Bahrain Darts Masters and another in the 2024 Premier League Play-Off final against Luke Humphries.

bespoke_faqs.q: How many major ranking titles did Luke Humphries capture during his breakthrough year?
bespoke_faqs.a: Between October 2023 and July 2024, Humphries won four consecutive premier ranking majors: the World Grand Prix, Grand Slam of Darts, Players Championship Finals, and World Championship, followed by the 2024 World Matchplay.

bespoke_faqs.q: Why is Luke Humphries nicknamed 'Cool Hand Luke'?
bespoke_faqs.a: His moniker 'Cool Hand Luke' derives from his icy composure under high-pressure checkout scenarios and is also a tribute to his father's love for Leeds United (spelling out LUKE: Leeds United Kings of Europe).

2020 UK Open (vs. Daryl Gurney)

bespoke_faqs.q: How many career televised nine-darters has Van Gerwen landed?
bespoke_faqs.a: Van Gerwen has recorded eight televised nine-dart finishes, including a famous perfect leg at the 2013 World Championship where he missed double 12 for back-to-back nine-darters.

career_prize_money.financial_note: Consistently inside top tier of PDC prize money earners.

2022 Premier League Belfast (two 9-darters in a single night!)

bespoke_faqs.a: Gerwyn Price played professional rugby union as a hooker for Neath and Cross Keys, and rugby league for South Wales Scorpions, before successfully transitioning to professional darts via PDC Q-School in 2014.

bespoke_faqs.q: When did Gerwyn Price win the PDC World Championship?
bespoke_faqs.a: Price won the PDC World Darts Championship in January 2021, defeating Gary Anderson 7–3 in the final to become the first Welsh player to capture the world title and claim world number one.

bespoke_faqs.q: What darts setup does Gerwyn Price throw in competition?
bespoke_faqs.a: Price uses 24-gram Red Dragon 'Iceman' signature darts featuring razor-edge and wave grip zones machined from 90% tungsten.

bespoke_faqs.q: How many Grand Slam of Darts titles has Gerwyn Price won?
bespoke_faqs.a: Price has won the prestigious Grand Slam of Darts three times (2018, 2019, and 2021), earning the nickname 'King of Aldersley' for his dominance in Wolverhampton.

major_pdc_titles: World Cup of Darts Champion (2024 with Luke Humphries)

history_highlights: 2019: Finalist (lost 3-7 to Michael van Gerwen)
2022: Finalist (lost 5-7 to Peter Wright)
2023: World Champion (defeated MVG 7-4 with iconic 9-dart leg in set 2)

notable_nine_darters: 2023 World Darts Championship Final (vs. Michael van Gerwen - voted the greatest leg in darts history)
2020 Premier League Dublin

financial_context: Smith's financial ledger is headlined by his £500,000 Ally Pally triumph in 2023 and Grand Slam victory, backed by consistent deep runs across the ProTour calendar.

bespoke_faqs.q: What happened in Michael Smith's famous nine-darter in the 2023 World Championship final?
bespoke_faqs.a: In what commentator Wayne Mardle called 'the greatest leg of darts in history', Michael van Gerwen missed double 12 for a nine-darter before Michael Smith immediately stepped up to complete a sensational nine-dart finish in the very same leg.

bespoke_faqs.q: When did Michael Smith become world number one?
bespoke_faqs.a: Smith attained the PDC world number one ranking immediately after defeating Michael van Gerwen 7–4 to win the 2023 PDC World Darts Championship on 3 January 2023.

bespoke_faqs.q: Which years did Peter Wright win the PDC World Darts Championship?
bespoke_faqs.a: Peter Wright won the World Championship twice: first in 2020 by defeating Michael van Gerwen 7–3, and again in 2022 by overcoming Michael Smith 7–5.

bespoke_faqs.q: Why does Peter Wright frequently change his darts during tournaments?
bespoke_faqs.a: Wright is renowned for constantly experimenting with barrel shapes, weights, coatings, and stems, adjusting his hardware mid-tournament based on venue humidity, airflow, and his release feel.

bespoke_faqs.a: His iconic look is styled by his wife Joanne, a professional hairdresser, who spends up to two hours before each televised match crafting his colorful mohawk and hand-painted snake head art.

bespoke_faqs.q: What major titles has Peter Wright won outside the World Championship?
bespoke_faqs.a: Wright's major cabinet includes the 2021 World Matchplay (lifting the Phil Taylor Trophy), the 2020 Masters, the 2021 Players Championship Finals, and two European Championships (2020, 2023).

bespoke_faqs.a: The 'Flying Scotsman' possesses what commentators widely regard as the smoothest, most natural throwing mechanics in darts history, characterized by an effortless fluid drawback and pinpoint follow-through.

bespoke_faqs.a: After a decade without a televised PDC major, Bunting adopted sports psychology, adjusted his barrel grip, and produced a masterclass at the 2024 Masters, defeating Michael van Gerwen 11–7 in the final to lift the trophy.

bespoke_faqs.q: What is Stephen Bunting's best run at the PDC World Championship?

name: Raymond van Barneveld

walk_on_atmosphere: Iconic boxing anthem accompanied by thousands of Dutch and international fans wearing orange 'Barney Army' shirts.
career_overview: A transcendent sporting icon who single-handedly brought darts to Dutch television. A five-time World Champion across two organizations (4x BDO, 1x PDC), Barney's 2007 PDC World Championship sudden-death victory over Phil Taylor is regarded as the greatest match ever played.
